import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-1094--h3--h2--h3--h1».Context

open scoped Nat

/-! Hole `h_close` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem erdos_1094__h3__h2__h3__h1 : ∃ (c : ℕ) (K : ℕ),
  ∀ (k : ℕ),
    K < k →
      ∃ (p : ℕ) (q : ℕ),
        Nat.Prime p ∧
          Nat.Prime q ∧
            k < (2 : ℕ) * p ∧
              p < q ∧ (16 : ℕ) * ((2 : ℕ) * q - k) ^ (4 : ℕ) ≤ k ^ (3 : ℕ) ∧ q - p ≤ c * Nat.log (2 : ℕ) k := by
  sorry
